title: Built-in strategy backtest
summary: Plan a built-in backtest with strategy_id and an explicit date window; confirm before run.
narrative:
A built-in backtest Job needs a strategy_id (for example macd or DMA). Dates and a symbol pool are optional slots: you can say them in the sentence or let profile.defaults fill optional shares/start/end/freq.

Plan shows `qt.ai.backtest.run_builtin` as dry-run. CLI `run "<query>"` is one confirmation. Unattended `agent_auto` also needs `profile.agent.allow_backtest=true`.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
plan = assistant.plan('用 macd 在沪深300上跑 2018-2023 回测', response_style='raw')
print(plan['plan']['steps'][0]['skill_name'])
risk_notes: Backtest is high-side-effect (heavy compute). Live trade is never auto-executed.
